notes.title: Game Update
notes.content:
Hello to all,

we released a new update on 7. November in which we correct all bugs previously reported to us and also we did some minor tweaks and performance improvements for smoother and better gameplay. 
What is fixed:
- now you can play the game past day 11 and enjoy the great story till the very exciting end.
- Steam achievements are active and ready for you to get them

We will hope that all of you can now fully enjoy playing Nora’s adventures. 

We wish you happy gaming,
Brave Giant LTD team
